what: crates/blaze-items/src/form.rs drops the MirLowerError where MIR fails to lower (lines 759, 769, 1763, 1825, 2264, 2283: `Err(_) => f.error(Missed::NoMir)`), so a build only says `Fn build_script_build::main has no hash: MIR that failed to lower` (hello3, b2-build/hello3-run.log). Keep the error, or at least its kind and the body, in what the build reports, so the cause is named. Rule 3: an error names what and where.
